label: rem:quaternionic-spectral-resolvents-remark
title: The balanced state and the jet-shell embedding
html: By the first power sum, the quaternionic spectral resolvent \omega_0 vanishes in the balanced state. The remaining coordinates \omega_1, \omega_2, \omega_3 embed Bring's surface into the infinite jet shell J^\infty E (jet shell).
heading: Remark
